description: This file handles the removal (deletion) of a mail scanner configuration in the vtiger CRM system. It includes necessary classes, performs a delete operation based on a scanner name request parameter, and redirects the user afterward.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerInfo
classes.description: Model class representing mail scanner information in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the mail scanner information from the database.
